runtime.direct_rve_timing_basis: median of repeated free-rotation equilibrium, energy, and full first-Piola stress recovery on a reused mesh; mesh construction is timed separately and amortized for the end-to-end comparison
runtime.surrogate_timing_basis: median of repeated energy plus full first-Piola stress evaluations; reference-state setup is timed separately and amortized for the end-to-end comparison

selection_method: deterministic, evenly spaced sampling by determinant over non-reference deformation groups; all test volume fractions retained per group
